Please note this is a fixed term position starting 16 November 2026 and finishing 12 February 2027




About the role:

We are looking for 4 final year undergrads or recent graduates to join our team as a Software Engineer Intern. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the software development field. 




As an intern, you will work closely with our engineering team, learning the fundamentals of software development in a supportive and collaborative environment and gain hands-on experience with the technologies shaping modern software — from TypeScript, React, and Node.js to AI tools and the cloud.




To be eligible for this role you must:

Have completed study (within the last 12 months) or be currently studying Computer Science or Software Engineering

Be studying at NZQA qualification level 6-10

Have not previously been employed by Calderwood in a FT position

Have not undertaken more than 2 pervious internships at Calderwood




The pay rate for this role is $29.90 per hour for the duration of the internship.




What will you be doing:

Learn and apply modern web development with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

Get exposure to deploying solutions on AWS or Azure.

Explore how AI tools can be used to improve real applications.

Work alongside senior engineers, gaining experience in debugging, testing, and real-world development.

Be part of a supportive team environment, contributing to real but intern-friendly projects.




What can you bring to this role:

Some knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks like React and Node.js.

Interest in cloud computing (AWS or Azure) and AI.

Exposure to other technologies (like .NET or Python) is a plus but not required.

A curious mindset, good communication, and teamwork skills.




Join the A today!

We welcome candidates who are eligible to work in Auckland, New Zealand. This is an in-office role. 




No visa sponsorship available for this role. 

We foster a culture of belonging, empowerment, and growth for all. If you require any specific support or adjustments throughout the recruitment process to enable you to put your best foot forward, please don’t hesitate to let us know. 

A background check and skills assessment form part of our recruitment process.

Please note that we do not accept applications from recruiters or agencies for this position.
